purpose: Paper-limitation supplements for the PPUBench run: held-out-only breakdown, corrected collateral wording, and checkpoint preservation. Does not modify any hashed artifact.

held_out_breakdown.note: E2E rows carry the per-image split; the strictly held-out subset is the last 3 sorted images per identity (12 images total: 3 forget, 9 retain). All-image composition and held-out results are reported separately as required.

g_route_evaluation.note: RD1 evaluates g on both composition and held-out test images.

wording_corrections.collateral: No observed collateral on the three tested retained identities (and their 57 route rows); this is NOT a general zero-collateral claim.
wording_corrections.scope: Single seed (17) and one forgotten identity (001). This remains a controlled pseudonymous association task on real images: it validates real-image routing and selective C->Y editing, not yet semantic/taxonomic/numeric granularity reduction.
wording_corrections.deletion_semantics: Refusal-targeted association suppression (abstention editing to 'Unknown'); retrain-equivalence is the separate leave-one-out oracle objective (oracle collapses 001 onto 'Seri').

checkpoint_archive.publication_action_required: Upload the archive (31MB) to a release archive or model repository before publication so the exact trained models are reloadable, not just hash-auditable.

test_rerun_note: The 30-test suite is GPU-free CPU pytest (tests/unit/test_research_validity.py). The manifest records '30 passed'; the recorded script/source hashes support independent rerun in any environment with pytest available.
